closing.summary: Big strengths are easy to use as a whole food, one of the clearest antioxidant-identity fruits, and hydrating whole-fruit package, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, low-calorie volume, and immune support because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, and vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
